svg.title: AINS platform: components and flows, phase by phase
svg.desc: Two columns left to right. Phase 1 builds the platform repo ains-platform directly from the workstation, edges P1 to P7. The platform runtime, used only by onboarded projects, holds Jira, the ains-orchestrator container with the Claude Code CLI stage agents, reusable workflows and credentials; agent usage is traced by edges A1 to A7. A placeholder on the right stands for onboarded projects, the sandbox in Phase 1 and ains-poc in Phase 2; diagram 2 covers a project story. Blue arrows are human to machine, teal arrows machine to machine.
svg.text: in this solo PoC one person holds every role; they are drawn separately to show the hand-offs. Phase 2 roles are in diagram 2.
Platform engineer: builds ains-platform directly in VS Code + Claude Code CLI, commits to main
Platform engineer: runs Jira setup, secret placement, bootstrap, then the acceptance story
Reviewer: approves G1–G5 on the acceptance story, so every gate is exercised once
Runtime roles (used only for onboarded projects)
Product owner: writes project stories in Jira, sets Execution Lane, orders the backlog
Reviewer: G1 spec and G2 plan decisions in Jira, Rework comments, Blocked calls
Platform engineer: keeps the container running, rotates tokens, tunes gates
(non-human) Claude Code CLI stage agents: act under the engineer's Max subscription
